src/data/author/dmitri.md.text: Platform engineer by trade. My work is getting an AI system past a corporate security review and into production, then handing it to the team that has to run it.
ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer — PECB course in progress, exam not taken yet

I work with companies of thirty to three hundred people who have run a few AI pilots and cannot get one into production. The blocker is rarely the model. It is who owns the risk, which data may reach a vendor, and whether anyone would notice if a prompt change made the output worse.
